graph.name: Revise quoted dialogue
graph.description:
Propose edits to paired quoted dialogue using a supplied conversational-speech reference.

Lesson: Register references make speech serve an immediate priority while dialogue scope preserves the surrounding scene.

Limitations: Quoted dialogue selection is mechanical, not inference about which lines are speech. Review any changed implication.

Opening makes this example the active workflow document. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Post: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Change Priority to reassuring a companion without changing the flooded road or delay.
Use a polite innkeeper's register and compare implication as well as sentence length.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Before: "Due to the fact that the road is flooded, our departure must be delayed."

After: "Road's flooded. We'll have to wait."

Speech path: reply.out → speech.in; brief.out → speech.reference; speech → validate → review → apply. One Prose call.

Purpose versus settings: Exposition level and speaker priority are Compose text. register mode does not select dialogue; scope remains independent.

Flooded-road explanation (reply)
Purpose: Freeze the latest completed text-only flooded-road reply.
Fixture: Tessa pointed at the water across the road. "Due to the fact that the road is flooded, our departure must be delayed." She set the travel bag on the bench.
Inspect: Confirm pointing, flooded road, delay and bag on bench.

Tessa · arrange the delay (brief)
Purpose: Supply Tessa's conversational priority.
Inspect: Samples provide register; carts are not scene facts.

Turn explanation into speech (speech)
Purpose: Recast explanation as practical speech.
Inspect: Both obstacle and delay survive; narration stays exact.

Output tokens includes visible text and any reasoning tokens counted by the provider. A truncated result is discarded; inspect the error, then manually raise the cap and rerun. No automatic retry occurs.

Check spoken-line patches (validate)
Purpose: Validate spoken-line replacements.
Inspect: Confirm unchanged pointing, bag and bench.

Review conversational intent (review)
Purpose: Require review of conversational intent.
Inspect: Reject omitted delay, new blame, panic or a different plan.

Offer natural road dialogue (apply)
Purpose: Offer natural road dialogue.
Inspect: Full root Host result: compare intent, then Apply or Reject.

sections.name: Priority
sections.text: Tessa needs companions to stop preparing to leave. Give the obstacle and consequence, not a formal report.

sections.name: Register
sections.text: Plain familiar speech; contractions welcome. No forced stammer, dialect spelling, filler or banter.

sections.name: Samples
sections.text: Original samples: The cart's stuck. Give me a hand. / No dry path through there. We'll wait here.

speech.title: Style Transfer
speech.instructions: Make the line spoken to companions. Retain flooded road and required delay with the same certainty. Add no time estimate, alternative route or feeling. Preserve narration.
